section_summary.extract_value: This Materials section describes four measurement instruments used in research on body image and cosmetic surgery attitudes: the Acceptance of Cosmetic Surgery Scale (ACSS), the Photographic Figure Rating Scale (PFRS), the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), and the Sociocultural Attitudes Toward Appearance Questionnaire-3 (SATAQ-3). The section details the structure, scoring, and psychometric properties of each instrument, noting cross-cultural variations in factor structure for some scales. No specific study data, sample characteristics, or correlational results are provided in this section.
